message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday (or is observed on a Monday when the actual holiday falls on a weekend), giving you at least three consecutive days off (the holiday + the adjacent weekend).

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 3, 2023** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday; the holiday was observed on Monday, creating a 3‑day break. |
| **Feb 18 – Feb 20, 2023** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Family Day is a provincial holiday; it fell on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend in those provinces. |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9, 2023** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a federal holiday; the weekend around it is a 3‑day break. |
| **May 20 – May 22, 2023** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is a federal holiday; it fell on Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3, 2023** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday; the holiday was observed on Monday, giving a 3‑day break. |
| **Sep 2 – Sep 4, 2023** | Labour Day | Labour Day is a federal holiday; it fell on Monday, creating a 3‑day weekend. |
| **Oct 7 – Oct 9, 2023** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday; it fell on Monday, giving a 3‑day weekend. |

### What about Christmas & Boxing Day?

- **Christmas Day (Dec 25 2023)** fell on a Monday, and **Boxing Day (Dec 26 2023)** on a Tuesday.  
  Because the holidays were on consecutive weekdays, they did **not** create a 3‑day weekend (the weekend before was Dec 23‑24).  

### Quick note on other provinces

Some provinces have additional holidays that can create long weekends (e.g., Heritage Day in Manitoba, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.).  The table above lists only the federal holidays that produced long weekends in 2023.  If you need province‑specific long weekends, let me know which provinces you’re interested in, and I can add those details.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
